description:
Return the AI-recommendation leaderboard for a product category.

Combines listed-market leaders (public data) with tracked B2B brands (GoAI Moat geo-footprint audit).
Useful when a user asks "who are the top Chinese suppliers of X" or "which brands does AI recommend in X".

Free tier. Available categories: connector, phone_case.
name: get_category_leaders
title: Get Category Leaders
